0.name: TEXT_REGGYR3PORTAPRAETORIA_00402_THORNEDCROW_000_000
0.description: Well, if it isn't <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I hope this <hex:02082EE3E90C0DFF14020810E3E90C05FF04657665FF056D6F726E03FF1302080FE3E90C12FF04646179FF046576650303> in Porta Praetoria finds you well.
0.translation_description: Ma guarda chi si vede, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Spero che tu stia trascorrendo una bella <hex:02083EE3E90C0DFF1C020818E3E90C05FF07736572617461FF0A6D617474696E61746103FF1B020817E3E90C12FF0967696F726E617461FF077365726174610303> a Porta Pretoria.

1.name: TEXT_REGGYR3PORTAPRAETORIA_00402_THORNEDCROW_000_001
1.description: An honor and a pleasure as always, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! What brings you all the way to Porta Praetoria on this fine <hex:02082EE3E90C0DFF14020810E3E90C05FF04657665FF056D6F726E03FF1302080FE3E90C12FF04646179FF046576650303>?
1.translation_description: Che onore e che piacere, come sempre, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Cosa ti porta fin qui a Porta Pretoria in questa bella <hex:02083EE3E90C0DFF1C020818E3E90C05FF07736572617461FF0A6D617474696E61746103FF1B020817E3E90C12FF0967696F726E617461FF077365726174610303>?

4.name: TEXT_REGGYR3PORTAPRAETORIA_00402_A1_000_002
4.description: What kind of place is this?

6.name: TEXT_REGGYR3PORTAPRAETORIA_00402_THORNEDCROW_000_010
6.description: Fight for the Ala Mhigan Resistance, what else? I was but a child when I fled the city with my parents, and I remember little of life before the Garleans came...but I still see her streets in my dreams.
6.translation_description: Combattere per la Resistenza di Ala Mhigo, che domande! Fuggii dalla città insieme ai miei genitori quand’ero ancora in tenera età, quindi ricordo poco di com’era la vita prima dell’arrivo dei Garleani... eppure nei sogni rivedo ancora le sue strade.

7.name: TEXT_REGGYR3PORTAPRAETORIA_00402_THORNEDCROW_000_011
7.description: Those memories are what brought me here. Though a part of me never thought we'd make it this far! I mean, by Rhalgr, we're within spitting distance of Cotter's citadel! We're almost there. We're almost home...
7.translation_description: Sono questi ricordi ad avermi portato fin qui, anche se una parte di me non credeva che saremmo arrivati a questo punto! Insomma, per Rhalgr, siamo a due passi dalla cittadella di Cotter! Ci siamo quasi. Quasi a casa...

8.name: TEXT_REGGYR3PORTAPRAETORIA_00402_THORNEDCROW_000_020
8.description: Protect and serve Ala Mhigo, what else? I was but a child when I fled the city with my parents, and I remember little of life before the Garleans came...but I still see her streets in my dreams.
8.translation_description: Proteggere e servire Ala Mhigo, che domande! Fuggii dalla città insieme ai miei genitori quand’ero ancora in tenera età, quindi ricordo poco di com’era la vita prima dell’arrivo dei Garleani... eppure nei sogni rivedo ancora le sue strade.

9.name: TEXT_REGGYR3PORTAPRAETORIA_00402_THORNEDCROW_000_021
9.description: Those memories are what brought me here. Though a part of me never thought we'd make it this far! I mean, by Rhalgr, we actually beat the bastards! Zenos and the lot of them! It's like something out of a song...
9.translation_description: E pensa, per Rhalgr! Abbiamo sconfitto davvero quei bastardi: Zenos e tutta la sua banda! Sembra una storia da canzone...

10.name: TEXT_REGGYR3PORTAPRAETORIA_00402_THORNEDCROW_000_030
10.description: Porta Praetoria? Our last camp before Ala Mhigo, and the point of entry to Castrum Abania. Though I reckon you know that since you came through there.
10.translation_description: Porta Pretoria? Il nostro ultimo accampamento prima di Ala Mhigo e la porta d’accesso al Castrum Abania. Immagino tu lo sappia già, visto che sei arrivato proprio da lì.

11.name: TEXT_REGGYR3PORTAPRAETORIA_00402_THORNEDCROW_000_031
11.description: This passage between the Peaks and the Lochs has always held strategic importance, but it was the Garleans who went and built a bloody fortress right on top of it.
11.translation_description: Il passaggio tra le Vette e i Laghi ha sempre avuto importanza strategica, ma i Garleani hanno pensato bene di costruirci sopra una dannata fortezza.

12.name: TEXT_REGGYR3PORTAPRAETORIA_00402_THORNEDCROW_000_032
12.description: Though it's our fortress now, heh heh, along with all her supplies! We've more than enough to sustain us through our assault on the city!
12.translation_description: Ma adesso la fortezza è nostra, ah ah, insieme a tutte le sue scorte! Ne abbiamo più che a sufficienza per sostenerci durante l’assalto alla città!

13.name: TEXT_REGGYR3PORTAPRAETORIA_00402_THORNEDCROW_000_040
13.description: Porta Praetoria? The last stop before Ala Mhigo, and the point of entry to Castrum Abania. Though I reckon you know that since you came through there.
13.translation_description: Porta Pretoria? L’ultima tappa prima di Ala Mhigo e la porta d’accesso al Castrum Abania. Immagino tu lo sappia già, visto che sei arrivato proprio da lì.

14.name: TEXT_REGGYR3PORTAPRAETORIA_00402_THORNEDCROW_000_041
14.description: This passage between the Peaks and the Lochs has always held strategic importance, but it was the Garleans who went and built a bloody fortress right on top of it.
14.translation_description: Il passaggio tra le Vette e i Laghi ha sempre avuto importanza strategica, ma i Garleani hanno pensato bene di costruirci sopra una dannata fortezza.

15.name: TEXT_REGGYR3PORTAPRAETORIA_00402_THORNEDCROW_000_042
15.description: I suppose we ought to thank 'em, eh? It'll come in handy should we need to repel another invasion. But let's all hope it doesn't come to that any time soon.
15.translation_description: Forse dovremmo perfino ringraziarli, eh? Potrebbe tornare utile se dovessimo respingere un’altra invasione. Ma speriamo tutti che non accada presto.
